+- id: graphics
+  name: Graphics & Image Tools
+  desc: Image editors, screenshot and annotation tools, diagram editors, OCR and image utilities.
+  packages:
+  - name: draw.io Desktop
+    desc: Online diagram software
+    homepage: https://www.diagrams.net/
+    cask: true
+    info: >-
+      draw.io (diagrams.net) is a desktop diagram and flowchart editor for flowcharts, process diagrams,
+      org charts, UML, ER and network diagrams. (source: https://www.diagrams.net/)
+    id: homebrew/cask/drawio
+    tags: [visualization, design, graphics]
+  - name: GIMP
+    desc: Free and open-source image editor
+    homepage: https://www.gimp.org/
+    cask: true
+    info: >-
+      GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is a free and open-source raster graphics editor used for
+      image retouching, free-form drawing, and converting between image formats. (source: https://www.gimp.org/)
+    id: homebrew/cask/gimp
+    tags: [graphics, design]
+  - name: Inkscape
+    desc: Vector graphics editor
+    homepage: https://inkscape.org/
+    cask: true
+    info: >-
+      Inkscape is a free and open-source vector graphics editor for creating illustrations, diagrams,
+      logos, and complex paintings. (source: https://inkscape.org/)
+    id: homebrew/cask/inkscape
+    tags: [graphics, design]
+  - name: pngpaste
+    desc: Paste PNG into files
+    homepage: https://github.com/jcsalterego/pngpaste
+    info: >-
+      pngpaste is a command-line tool that pastes PNG images from the clipboard into files. Useful for
+      quickly saving clipboard images to disk on macOS. (source: https://github.com/jcsalterego/pngpaste)
+    id: homebrew/core/pngpaste
+    tags: [command-line, graphics, utility]
+  - name: tesseract
+    desc: OCR (Optical Character Recognition) engine
+    homepage: https://tesseract-ocr.github.io/
+    info: >-
+      Tesseract is an open-source OCR engine that recognizes text in images and converts it to machine-readable text. (source: https://tesseract-ocr.github.io/)
+    id: homebrew/core/tesseract
+    tags: [graphics, conversion]
+  - name: flameshot
+    desc: Screenshot software with built-in annotation tools
+    homepage: https://flameshot.org/
+    cask: true
+    id: homebrew/cask/flameshot
+    info: >-
+      Flameshot is a screenshot tool with built-in annotation features. Note: this cask is marked deprecated in Homebrew and scheduled to be disabled on 2026-09-01. (source: https://flameshot.org/)
+    tags: [graphics, screenshot, productivity]
